brand.name: Your Business
site.title: Your Business — Book online
site.description: Book your appointment online in a few steps: choose a service, pick a time that suits you, and confirm.
home.hero.title: Book the right time, without the back-and-forth.
home.hero.summary: Choose a service, pick a time that suits you, and confirm your booking in a few simple steps — any time, from any device.
home.services.title: Our services
home.services.intro: Choose a service to see its open times and book directly.
home.availability.title: Check open times
home.availability.intro: Search the next seven days before you book, in the time zone that suits you.
home.manage.title: Already booked?
home.manage.body: Open the link in your confirmation email to view your booking, move it to another time, or cancel it.
footer.contact.title: Contact us
footer.contact.body: Questions about a booking? Reply to your confirmation email and our team will get back to you.
pwa.offline.title: You are offline
pwa.offline.body: This page needs an internet connection. Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data, then try again.
pwa.install.title: Install the {name} app
pwa.install.intro: Add {name} to your home screen or desktop to book in one tap. It opens like an app and always shows the latest open times.
whatsapp.optIn.label: Also send updates on WhatsApp
whatsapp.optIn.consent: I agree to receive messages about this booking — its confirmation, reminders and any changes — on WhatsApp at the number I enter here. My mobile provider's usual data charges may apply.
